sources.title: 中 아연도금강판 반덤핑 최종 판정…5년간 최대 33.67% 관세
evidence: 중국산 아연도금강판에 최대 33.67%의 덤핑방지관세가 5년간 부과될 전망이다.
무역위는 중국산 제품의 저가 수입으로 국내 산업이 피해를 입었다고 판단하고, 향후 5년간 22.34~33.67%의 덤핑방지관세를 부과하도록 재정경제부에 건의하기로 했다.
업체별 관세율은 내몽골 바오터우강철 22.34%, 서우강징탕 26.28%, 윈스톤디벨롭먼트 33.67%로 결정됐다.
바오산강철과 우한강철, 산둥강철 등 그 밖의 공급업체에는 25.75%가 적용된다.
재정경제부가 관세 부과와 가격약속 수락 여부를 최종 결정한다.

sources.title: Rio Tinto to invest $1.9 billion in Queensland bauxite project
evidence: Rio Tinto (ASX: RIO) said on Friday it will invest $1.9 billion to develop the Kangwinan bauxite project in Queensland
The miner said the investment would add 20 million tonnes of annual bauxite production in Weipa
with first output targeted in 2029 and full production expected by 2032.
while increasing Weipa’s annual production capacity to about 44 million tonnes from around 38 million tonnes currently.
The development will also help offset the planned 2029 closure of Rio’s Gove bauxite mine in the Northern Territory.

sources.title: APLA ‘26: LatAm recycled plastics bank on mandates to offset weak demand
evidence: Demand for most recycled resin grades has remained subdued throughout 2026
established minimum recycled-content targets beginning in 2026.
upcoming regulations expected to establish mandatory post-consumer recycled (PCR) content requirements in 2027.
compliance with recycled-content obligations will only be allowed through domestically collected waste feedstock.
Regulation is increasingly viewed as the primary catalyst for future market growth.
